description: What the Operator window is allowed to ask the shell for. Without this file the window is granted NOTHING: Tauri v2 gates every core API behind a capability, so listen() was being denied and the tray's toggles reached a page that could not hear them. Custom commands (log_line, set_mic_state, summon_window, exit_fullscreen) are not gated and were working the whole time, which is exactly what made this hard to see.
